answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 63191 Country: India Title: Job In Financing company Question: I work in a Finance Corporation, as accountant the company also prepares project reports for starting business to entrepreneurs and also serves as nodal agency for disbursement of Govt of India subsidies to factories. Is it Halal or Haram? If Haram, then can I continue till I get a new job? Answer ID: 63191 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 189/189/SD=04/1437) If you are only assigned to prepare the report of the project on the post of accountant in the said company and you are not responsible to carry out any non-Shariah task then this job is lawful for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
